testcase.name: wrong familiar cannot consume testudo scroll or energy
ophidian incubation transforms a verified egg but rejects an unmapped item
testudo boosts defence and consumes exactly one scroll and twenty points
winter storage banks one selected item and consumes resources only on success
immense heat opens the jewellery crafting interface only with a gold bar and consumes one scroll and six points
blood drain deals flat self-damage, cures poison and requires six lifepoints
N516 Howl refuses a guard without spending resources and still works on a man or woman
herbcall spawns a grimy herb and consumes exactly one scroll and twelve points
steel of legends queues four ranged strikes and consumes once
dispatcher resolves the right binding by active familiar, not a component id
swallow whole heals for the cooked fish's value and consumes exactly one scroll and three points
